_comment: ADR-037 register fragment: journeys (journey-designer, ADR-085 §6). Adds a NEW disjoint schema key `journey` to the shared `buildiq` register's components.schemas map; no existing schema is touched. A journey is the Journey Designer's ordered steps over form-library forms: a `form` step holds the `formId` of the form it references and never field definitions of its own; a step may carry `branch` rules (visibleWhen predicates) and `writes` (objects the submitted journey creates). Only administrators author journeys: buildiq's save route refuses anyone else, and the schema's create/update/delete authorization is admin as well.

journey.title: Journey
journey.description: A journey authored in the Journey Designer: its ordered steps (forms from the form library, a review, a confirmation), the branch rules between them and the objects the submitted journey writes.

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description: OpenRegister-assigned unique identifier for this journey. Not supplied by the client on create.

title.title: Title
title.description: The journey's name, shown above its steps.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The ordered steps. Each is `{ id, type, title }` with `type` form, review or confirmation; a form step adds `formId` (the form-library form it references), optional `branch: [{ when, goto }]` and optional `writes: [{ as, register, schema, mapping }]`; a confirmation step adds `message`.
